jobs.description:
The Business Analyst – Investment Governance & Performance plays a pivotal role in shaping our global retail footprint. In this role you will be responsible for optimizing and controlling all Pandora’s investments in store leases, acquisitions and other network actions. By owning and driving best practices in investment evaluation, you will help support the strategic growth and profitability through data-driven decision-making on our global store network.

You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management Team as well as local property and network teams, delivering high-quality analysis and recommendations to drive strategic initiatives such as store openings, closures, relocations, Forward Integrations and lease renewals.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• 
Evaluate and Review Investment Proposals.

• 
Ensure the accuracy and completeness of all submitted investment proposals (IPs).

• 
Validate compliance with accounting standards, including IFRS16 regulations.

• 
Assess business cases for financial impact and strategic alignment.

• 
Share approved IPs with the CCO/CEO/CFO for final sign-off.

• 
Track, Report and Analyse Investments.

• 
Maintain and update the global investment overview.

• 
Report and review the investment proposals vs actual performance in the hindsight report to measure accuracy.

• 
Deliver insights to enhance the accuracy of future investment decisions.

• 
Lead Bi-Weekly Investment Review Meetings

• 
Coordinate and host approval meetings with the Global Network & Franchise management team.

• 
Present investment proposals from market clusters for review and global approval.

• 
Develop and Improve Internal Tools and Processes

• 
Continuously improve reports, presentations and templates to reflect the strategic priorities and regulatory requirements.

• 
Promote and implement global best practices across clusters.

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration

• 
Act as a trusted advisor to Global Network & Franchise management, Global Finance, Cluster Property and Cluster finance teams.

• 
Provide analytical support and challenge local teams to ensure business cases are both realistic and profitable.

**Your team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora’s global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Finance Directors and General Managers to drive performance, ensure retail excellence, and execute on global priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and join a high-impact team focused on data-led strategy and investment optimization.

**What We’re Looking For

**We are looking for a proactive and analytical team player with a strong business acumen and a critical mindset. You have a talent for transforming data into insights and a passion for driving performance through collaboration and strategic thinking.

**Your Qualifications Include

**

• A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role; experience in retail, real estate, fashion or FMCG is a plus.

• Proven ability to deliver insights through reports, dashboards, and presentations.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience communicating with senior leadership.

• Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with Power Automate and Power BI/Query is a strong advantage.

**AI & Automation/Optimization

**We expect our future colleague to actively embrace the evolving role of AI and automation in business analysis. This means leveraging AI-powered tools to streamline investment evaluation workflows and enhance reporting accuracy.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band: 5B

Start date: Ideally, January 1, 2027

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable **and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.****About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Technical expert in inks & coatings, plastics: Technical Product Specialist or Head of Product Development
jobs.description:
About Octarine

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based biotech company making safe, sustainable, bio-based pigments. Our PurePalette™ platform uses precision fermentation and renewable raw materials to produce colourants that can replace petrochemical and mined pigments.

We are a team of around 15 people, working across pigment manufacturing, formulation and application development, and commercial development. As our pigment manufacturing processes reach full commercial scale, and our first pigment products are now in the hands of customers and partners, we are looking for someone with deep domain expertise in one or more of our core application areas (dyeing, printing, coatings and plastics) to make PurePalette™ work in real industrial applications and turn successful customer trials into lasting commercial products.

The role

You will be the technical owner of the PurePalette™ product range and the link between our lab and our customers. You will translate what the market needs into clear performance targets, work with our scientists to meet them, and make sure our pigment products perform once they reach a customer's processes.

We are looking for an applications expert in inks and coatings, plastics, or both, or in a closely related pigment application field. The title and scope will match your experience:

• Technical Product Specialist if you are earlier in your career and want a role with a lot of room to grow as the company scales.

• Head of Product Development if you have the experience to lead the product and applications function, shape the product roadmap and build a team.

In both cases you will report directly to our Chief Scientific Officer and work closely with our commercial team.

What you will do

Own the product, technically

• Be the technical expert for all PurePalette™ products and the first point of contact for technical questions from customers, partners and colleagues.

• Define the performance and quality parameters customers expect in each application, such as colour strength, dispersibility, heat stability, light and weather fastness, migration, rheology, and wash and rub fastness.

• Plan and coordinate the internal and external testing needed to prove each parameter, and turn the results into clear data packages for customers.

• Own, write and maintain our technical and product documentation, including Safety Data Sheets (SDS), Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Certificates of Analysis (CoA), product specifications and application guides.

Make our pigments work for customers

• Work with customers, distributors and partners to implement PurePalette™ products in their processes, from first lab trial to production run.

• Own the technical side of our partnerships with masterbatchers, ink manufacturers, dyehouses and research institutes. Set up project plans, manage technology transfer between parties, and troubleshoot problems until the product works in the target application.

• Handle technical customer feedback and complaints, find the root cause and feed lessons back into product and process development.

Decide what to develop next

• Identify where bio-based pigments offer real value to end users, and where they can genuinely meet customers' performance expectations.

• Work with Octarine scientists to map which applications our current pigments suit, and which applications we should target with future products.

• Work with our formulation and application scientists to refine formulations (dispersions, masterbatches, inks, dye and print pastes) to meet customer requirements.

• Work with our R&D and process teams to develop and implement strategies that improve pigment performance, for example through stabilisation, surface treatment or particle engineering.

• Benchmark our products against incumbent pigments and competing bio-based alternatives.

Connect technical and commercial

• Act as the bridge between Octarine's technical and commercial teams, translating customer needs into technical requirements and technical results into customer value.

• Join customer meetings, site visits and trade fairs as the technical voice of the company.

• Contribute technical content to sales materials, grant applications and investor discussions, and help capture new inventions for our IP portfolio.

What you bring

Pigment applications are many markets, not one. Printing inks alone span flexo, gravure, offset, screen and digital printing, and each places different demands on a pigment. The end markets differ just as much, from packaging and textiles to toys, consumer goods and coatings, each with its own performance, safety and regulatory requirements.

We need someone who knows this landscape in depth. You should understand the technical and performance requirements of each sub-application and market, judge where our pigments have a realistic and valuable fit, and work with our scientists to develop products that meet those requirements.

Specifically, we are looking for:

• An MSc or PhD in chemistry, polymer or materials science, chemical engineering, colour science or a related field, or equivalent industrial experience.

• Hands-on industrial experience applying pigments or colourants in textiles, inks and coatings, plastics and masterbatch, or a closely related field. For the Head of Product Development level, we expect around 5 or more years, including leading projects or people.

• A practical understanding of pigment dispersion and of how pigment properties such as particle size, surface chemistry and thermal stability affect performance in the final product.

• Experience with colour measurement (spectrophotometry, CIELAB, ΔE) and with standard ISO, EN or ASTM test methods for pigment and application performance.

• Experience writing or maintaining SDS, TDS and CoA documents, and working knowledge of REACH and CLP.

• Experience working directly with customers or external partners on trials, scale-up or technology transfer.

• The ability to explain technical results clearly to scientists, customers and commercial colleagues.

• A structured, self-driven way of working, and comfort with the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage company.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• The confidence to take full ownership of the role from day one. You will set your own priorities, make decisions within your remit and drive projects to completion without close supervision, keeping the CSO informed rather than waiting for direction.

Nice to have

• Experience in both inks and coatings and plastics.

• Experience with textile dyeing or printing.

• Experience with organic pigments, natural colourants or other bio-based materials.

• Knowledge of food contact and product safety requirements, such as EU 10/2011, the Swiss Ordinance, EuPIA guidelines, EN 71-3 or ZDHC.

• Experience with quality systems such as ISO 9001, or with setting product specifications for a new product.

• An existing network in the European ink, coatings, masterbatch or textile industries.

What we offer

• A central role in bringing a new class of sustainable pigments to market, with real influence over which products we build and how.

• Direct work with the founding team and a short path from idea to decision.

• A small, highly skilled team of scientists across synthetic biology, fermentation, downstream processing, formulation and application.

• For earlier-career candidates, a role that can grow with the company. For senior candidates, the chance to build and lead the product function.

• Real autonomy and ownership of your work, and the chance to make a lasting impact at a fast-growing company developing new materials for industries that urgently need to change.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark. On-site is strongly preferred; hybrid working is possible for the right candidate.

Start date: As soon as possible

Reports to: Chief Scientific Officer

Employment: Full-time, permanent

Travel: Some travel to customers and partners within Europe

Right to work: Applicants must already have the right to live and work in Denmark. We are unfortunately not able to sponsor work visas at this time.

How to apply

Apply with your CV. Please highlight the pigment applications you have worked on and a technical problem you solved in a customer's process.

We review applications on a rolling basis and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply early.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are happy to answer questions about the role before you apply.

Sophion Bioscience is looking for an ambitious, customer-focused Vice President of Research & Development to lead and further develop our R&D organization.

This is a central leadership role with responsibility for Sophion’s technology strategy, product development execution, engineering capabilities, and R&D organization. You will ensure that priorities, resources, budgets, and development activities are managed with clarity and discipline, enabling us to deliver high-quality products that create measurable value for customers.

You will report to the CEO and as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will contribute to Sophion’s overall direction and continued growth.

About the role

As VP R&D, you will lead and develop Sophion’s multidisciplinary R&D organization, setting a clear direction and creating the structure, leadership, and ways of working needed to deliver on our ambitions.

You will translate product and portfolio priorities into clear R&D priorities, roadmaps, and resource commitments, ensuring alignment and accountability across the organization. Working closely with Innovation, Market & Product Management, you will ensure R&D brings strong judgment and execution discipline to the development of differentiated and commercially successful products.

A key part of your mandate will be to strengthen the R&D organization and its leadership. You will develop leaders, build effective teams, establish clear governance and decision-making, and create a culture of collaboration, ownership, and delivery.

You will attract, develop, and retain talented people and ensure that R&D continues to grow in capability, maturity, and performance.

About Us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ on a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are driven by curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for helping scientists succeed. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share knowledge freely, support each other across roles and borders, and take pride in doing things properly. Our culture is informal, trusting, and grounded in respect — for colleagues, customers, and the science we enable. Even as we grow globally, we remain a company where people feel welcome, included, and able to make a meaningful impact.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

• Set and execute Sophion’s R&D and technology strategy in alignment with the company’s overall direction and priorities.

• Lead and develop the R&D organization, including its structure, leadership capabilities, ways of working, and competencies.

• Clearly communicate R&D priorities, progress, risks, and trade-offs across Sophion and to the Leadership Team and Board.

• Own the R&D budget and ensure resources are allocated to the activities that create the greatest strategic and customer value.

• Drive portfolio and resource management, translating product priorities into actionable development roadmaps and execution commitments while balancing short- and long-term priorities.

• Ensure customer needs inform development decisions by driving broad R&D engagement with the market, key opinion leaders, and key accounts.

• Strengthen development governance, decision-making, accountability, milestones, KPIs, and transparent reporting.

• Drive continuous improvement in product quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

• Work closely with Innovation, Market & Product Management to assess opportunities and convert agreed priorities into robust and commercially viable products.

• Maintain appropriate quality and compliance standards across R&D activities.

• Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Who You Are

You are a strategic and hands-on R&D leader who can turn complex scientific and technical opportunities into high-quality products.

You bring clarity to complex situations and combine strong judgment with disciplined execution. You build strong teams, set clear priorities, use resources effectively, and deliver commitments.

You are engaging and decisive, and you build trust through transparency, communication, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through. You are comfortable moving between strategic questions and operational details without losing sight of R&D and company priorities.

We expect that you:

• Master’s degree in science, engineering, technology, or a related field.

• Proven R&D leadership experience in complex, multidisciplinary product development, leading leaders and sizeable teams of specialized engineers and scientists across hardware, software, firmware & bioscience.

• Strong communicator with the ability to set the agenda, shape strategy, and communicate in a clear direction across the organization and with customers and investors.

• Track record of taking products from concept to successful global market use.

• Experience from life science tools, diagnostics, MedTech, laboratory instrumentation, or similar quality-critical environments is preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to improve execution, prioritization, organizational capability, and product quality.

• Strong strategic, customer, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and deliver results.

• Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with professional English proficiency.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Helene Fife on hef@Sophion.com

Start Date

As soon as possible.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

**Technical Fluency

**

**What This Role Is Not

**We Can Offer

**

• Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• A competitive salary and benefits package.

• A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The position as Payroll Specialist - Mid EU will be a part of our Financial Shared Services department, which also includes Accounting and Accounts Payables. The position will be embedded and report to the Global Payroll Manager in the HQ - Copenhagen, Denmark. This role provides potential for growth within the company and the role offers an exciting opportunity for the right candidate to develop their career within Joe & The Juice. The role is a full-time position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• The overall responsibility will be processing monthly Payroll in the following markets: Belgium, France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Monaco and Germany (Note: all mid-EU payrolls are outsourced; you will be coordinating with a provider - for now; exception made for France and the Netherlands where it is done in-house).

• Fielding employee questions regarding pay.

• Responsible to onboard new joiners into payroll systems.

• Responsible to keep HRIS/employee data up-to-date, in cooperation with local HR teams, in regard to leave and absence, personal data, etc.

• Reconciling payroll data against accounting records, preparing and reviewing payroll-related bookings and journal entries, and supporting month-end close.

• Acting as the point of coordination between local HR, Finance and external payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery.

• Ad-hoc HR / Payroll tasks as necessary.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You have high attention to detail and a strong sense of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee data.

• You have strong communication skills and can liaise confidently with employees, HR, Finance and external payroll providers.

• You can manage competing deadlines across multiple markets and payroll cycles simultaneously.

• You have a proactive, problem-solving mindset and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Experience in multi-jurisdiction payroll, ideally covering 2 or more countries within the Mid Europe market (Belgium, France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Germany, Monaco).

• Fluent English required. Working proficiency in Dutch, German and/or French is a strong asset.

• Accounting experience, including reconciliation, bookings/journal entries and month-end close support.

• Solid understanding of payroll principles and local labor/tax compliance across two or more Mid Europe markets.

• Proficiency with Excel and payroll/HRIS systems; comfortable working with large datasets.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Who is Understory?

Understory is a vertical-focused software platform built for experience businesses – from kayaking tours to cooking classes. Our operating system helps creators manage operations, grow bookings, accept payments, and run their business with clarity and less stress.

We move fast, iterate quickly, and expect everyone to bring proactive solutions every day. You'll learn faster here than almost anywhere else because the challenges are real and the pace is high. This isn't about clocking in and out – the right candidate will get a lot of trust and ownership, and it's all about building something that matters to creators around the world.

We recently raised a €12M Series A and are scaling fast. With customers in 10+ countries and a growing presence internationally, our focus is global, our ambition is high, and our team is fully committed to being the go-to platform for experience creators worldwide.

In keeping with this momentum, we are growing our team across Copenhagen and Barcelona and doubling down on our Nordic markets.

About the Role

As our Nordic Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving revenue growth in our Nordic markets from our Copenhagen or Barcelona office. You'll own the sales process from qualified opportunity to signed customer, helping experience providers discover how Understory can support and grow their businesses.

You'll work closely with SDRs, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to create a seamless customer journey while providing valuable market insights that help shape our growth strategy in the Nordics.

Convert qualified leads into paying customers through effective negotiation and closing.

Months 7–12 - Revenue: Achieve or exceed revenue targets while contributing to Understory's long-term growth in the Nordics.

What We're Looking For

You need to be native in one of our Nordic markets: native level of Danish, Swedish or Norwegian, plus fluency in English (written and spoken).

2+ years of B2B sales experience, either as a top-performing SDR/BDR or as an Account Executive.

Strong negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.

Passion for experiences, travel, and supporting entrepreneurs.

Someone living in either Copenhagen or Barcelona to join one of our offices.

Nice to have:

• 
Existing network within the Danish, Swedish or Norwegian tourism or events sector.

• 
Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive.

• 
Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

• 
Additional European language capabilities.

Why You'll Thrive at Understory

• 
Be part of a high-growth company redefining the experience economy worldwide.

• 
Join Understory at a pivotal moment in our Nordic markets: as part of our growing Nordic team, you will help shape our regional strategy, local team culture, and market footprint.

• 
Work from our Copenhagen or Barcelona office while helping shape our growth in the Nordics.

• 
Enjoy autonomy, flexibility, and ownership in a fast-moving environment.

• 
Collaborate with ambitious colleagues who are passionate about building meaningful products.

• 
Benefit from significant opportunities for professional development and career progression.

Start Date & Application

If you're a high-achieving closer who is ready to take ownership of revenue growth and leave your mark as an Account Executive in the Nordics, we want to hear from you! Apply below to join us.

**Job Description Summary

**The Production Engineer – Project Engineer works hands-on with manufacturing and cross-functional teams to implement product and process changes for medical devices used in ultrasound, surgical visualization, and image-guided procedures.

The role supports manufacturing across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration and loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

This is a hands-on manufacturing engineering role, working directly with operators, technicians, engineers, and SMEs on the production floor to troubleshoot issues, execute trials and first builds, collect and evaluate data, implement process changes, and verify solutions in the actual manufacturing environment

The position combines practical manufacturing engineering with three core areas: ECO/NPI implementation and manufacturing readiness; NC, INV and CAPA activities and Equipment Qualification/Process Validation.

**Job Description

****This is an onsite opportunity at our manufacturing site in Herlev, Denmark.

****Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Lead ECO implementation, NPI, and manufacturing change activities from production impact assessment and cut-in strategy through implementation and closure.

• Coordinate first builds and production trials, including process updates, SOP/WI changes, training, data and evidence collection, and implementation reporting.

• Work hands-on with operators and technicians on the production floor to troubleshoot manufacturing issues, implement process changes, and verify solutions.

• Own and drive NC, INV, and CAPA activities (TrackWise), including investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, implementation, effectiveness checks, and closure.

• Facilitate root cause investigations and define corrective actions together with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and relevant SMEs.

• Lead and support Equipment Qualification and Process Validation, including risk assessments, validation planning, protocol execution, documentation, and reporting.

• Support URS, IQ/OQ/PQ, equipment qualification, test method validation, revalidation, and ongoing process review, as applicable.

• Develop and improve manufacturing processes using pFMEA, Control Plans, risk management, process controls, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure manufacturing changes, investigations, equipment, and processes are appropriately documented, controlled, validated, traceable, and audit-ready.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with manufacturing engineering, ECO implementation, NPI, or sustaining engineering.

• Experience with NC, INV, CAPA, root cause analysis, and Quality System workflows.

• Experience with or strong understanding of Equipment Qualification and Process Validation.

• Knowledge of GMP, Quality Management Systems, risk management, and manufacturing process controls.

• Experience working in medical device or other regulated manufacturing environments.

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality.

**Desired Characteristics (nice to have)

**

• Hands-on experience with medical device manufacturing and manufacturing process development/improvement.

• Strong project execution and manufacturing change implementation skills.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause investigation capabilities.

• Experience with equipment qualification, process validation, and risk-based manufacturing activities.

• Structured and disciplined approach to documentation, workflows, actions, and deadlines.

• Proactive and solution-oriented with strong ownership and accountability.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.

• Ability to balance ECO/NPI, Quality System activities, validation, compliance, and production priorities

Are you ready to combine hands-on IT support with technical development in an international shipping company?

At Clipper Bulk, we are looking for an IT Operations & Support Specialist to join our IT team at our headquarters in Copenhagen.

This is an opportunity to become a key part of our IT function, ensuring reliable day-to-day support while gradually taking on broader responsibilities within IT operations, Microsoft 365 and infrastructure.

As IT Operations & Support Specialist, you will play an important role in keeping our IT environment running smoothly and supporting colleagues across the organisation. You will take ownership of daily IT support in close collaboration with the rest of the IT team, while also contributing to the maintenance, improvement and development of our IT systems.

Over time, you will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility for operational tasks and smaller IT projects.

What will be your responsibilities:

• Providing hands-on IT support and troubleshooting for colleagues

• Managing and maintaining Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID, Exchange Online and Intune

• Supporting device management, user administration and employee onboarding and offboarding

• Handling day-to-day IT operational tasks and ensuring system stability

• Supporting identity and access management, endpoint security and IT infrastructure

• Maintaining IT documentation, procedures and best practices

• Identifying opportunities to improve and automate IT processes

• Participating in smaller IT operations and infrastructure projects

What we are looking for:

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys both IT support and technical operations. You are comfortable taking responsibility for day-to-day support, but you are also curious about the technology behind the systems and motivated to expand your technical capabilities. You don't just wait for the next support ticket. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement and follow tasks through to completion.

We imagine that you bring:

• Practical experience with IT support and technical troubleshooting

• Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, including Entra ID and related services

• Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management and Windows client administration

• A good understanding of user management, access rights and IT security principles

• A structured and independent approach to solving technical challenges

• Good communication skills and a service-minded attitude

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken

• Experience with IT security and endpoint security solutions, network infrastructure, PowerShell, IT automation, identity and access management, IT projects or AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A varied role combining hands-on support, IT operations and technical development.

• The opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and technical expertise.

• Close collaboration with experienced IT colleagues.

• An international working environment with colleagues across our global offices.

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site parking, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process:

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 29th November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consists of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview conducted via video call. Candidates progressing to the second round will be invited to an in-person interview and asked to complete a personality assessment and a logical reasoning test beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide__. We are a global workplace built on five shared values: Dependable, Curious, Collaboration, Hands-on and Family. We believe in learning from one another and welcome people with a growth mindset and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website.

jobs.occupation: Analyst in Capital Planning – Help Shape the Bank’s Financial Future
jobs.description:
Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management.

What you will be doing

The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process.

More specifically, you will:

• Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections

• Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams

• Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers

• Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs

• Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables

About you

• Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English

• Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field

• Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals

Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience.

What we offer you

You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

At Saxo, we believe that security enables our business to grow, innovate, and serve clients with confidence. We are looking for a highly experienced Head of Physical Security & Safety to lead and strengthen our global physical security framework, ensuring the protection of our employees, facilities, assets, and operations across all Saxo locations.

This is a unique opportunity to shape and mature a critical capability within a global financial institution while influencing security standards, processes, and culture across multiple locations.

About the role

As Head of Physical Security & Safety, you will be responsible for protecting Saxo's people, facilities, operations and reputation across multiple international locations.

You will lead the development of our physical security framework, drive risk-based security initiatives, strengthen preparedness and crisis response capabilities, and ensure that security remains aligned with the evolving threat landscape.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders, facility management, IT Security, Risk, Compliance, and international office representatives to ensure a consistent and robust security posture across the bank.

Your responsibilities

• 
Lead Saxo's physical security and safety programme across global locations.

• 
Identify, assess and mitigate threats and vulnerabilities affecting employees, facilities and business operations.

• 
Develop and implement security policies, standards and operating procedures.

• 
Drive incident management, investigations and corrective actions where required.

• 
Strengthen emergency preparedness, crisis response and resilience capabilities.

• 
Oversee physical security technologies including access control, CCTV and alarm systems.

• 
Provide strategic security advice to senior management and key stakeholders.

• 
Manage security service providers and external security partners.

• 
Promote a security-aware culture through training and awareness programmes.

• 
Support major events, critical incidents and business continuity initiatives.

Your profile

You may come from law enforcement, the military, intelligence services, critical infrastructure, corporate security or a similar environment where security, risk management and operational leadership have been central to your role.

We expect you to bring:

• Extensive experience within physical security, protective security or security operations.

• A strong understanding of threat assessment, risk management and incident response.

• Experience leading security programmes, projects or specialist teams.

• The ability to advise and influence senior stakeholders.

• A calm and structured approach in high-pressure situations.

• Strong personal integrity, sound judgement and discretion.

• Fluency in English and Danish.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager for the DK Pension to take responsibility for the ongoing management and development of Saxo’s Danish pension offering.

About the job

The role combines pension domain responsibility with senior product management. You will work with the regulatory, operational and commercial aspects of the pension offering, while also helping to drive the product roadmap and digital development.

You will collaborate across business, technology and control functions and play an important role in translating pension regulation, client needs and business requirements into product priorities and solutions.

Key responsibilities

DK Pension and domain management

• Take responsibility for the Danish pension offering and its ongoing development

• Maintain a strong understanding of Danish bank pension regulation, taxation and relevant market developments, and translate changes into business and product requirements

• Help ensure that the pension offering remains compliant and operationally sound in collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Tax and Operations

• Act as a pension subject-matter expert and point of contact across relevant parts of the organisation

• Support operational teams with pension-related processes, requirements and work instructions where needed

• Manage relationships with an external pension vendor as well as partners, including new requirements, changes and prioritisation

• Participate in external forums and working groups to keep current with market best practices and upcoming regulatory changes

Senior Product Management

• Own and develop the product vision and roadmap for the pension offering, balancing regulatory requirements, client needs and business priorities

• Work with the Head of Pension to manage and prioritise the development backlog based on business needs, client value, regulatory requirements and technical dependencies

• Translate pension, tax and regulatory requirements into clear product and development requirements

• Work closely with technology teams throughout development and implementation

• Coordinate across Technology, Onboarding, Operations, Legal, Compliance and other relevant stakeholders

• Contribute to the continued development of the digital pension customer journey, including opportunities to improve usability and self-service

• Follow initiatives from initial requirements through implementation and subsequent improvements

Your profile

We are looking for someone with practical knowledge of pensions and experience from the Danish financial sector who is comfortable working with both product development and regulatory requirements.

You may currently work within a pension company, bank, investment firm or another regulated financial institution.

We expect that you bring:

• Relevant professional experience from the Danish financial sector, with experience related to bank pension framework; ratepension, aldersopsparing and kapitalpension

• Good knowledge of Danish pension products and the regulatory and tax framework surrounding them

• Experience from a product-focused role, such as Product Owner, Product Manager, pension product specialist, business developer or a similar position

• Experience translating regulatory, business or operational requirements into product solutions

• Experience working with digital development and prioritising requirements or a product backlog

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• A structured approach to prioritisation and the ability to work with regulatory, operational, commercial and client considerations simultaneously

• Fluent in Danish and English

Nice to have

• Experience with digital investment or trading platforms

• Knowledge of Aktiesparekonto (ASK) and the broader Danish investment and savings landscape

• Experience collaborating with external pension providers, administrators or technology vendors

• A member of external forums and established working groups with deep technical expertise & an industry-wide network

About you

You have a solid understanding of pensions and an interest in how pension products can be developed and improved through digital solutions.

You are comfortable working with different types of stakeholders, from Compliance and Legal to Operations and Technology, and can translate pension-related requirements into practical solutions.

The role could suit someone who has already worked as a Product Owner or Product Manager within pensions, but it could also be relevant for an experienced pension professional who has worked closely with digital product development.

You combine pension knowledge with a structured and collaborative approach and are comfortable taking responsibility for both the day-to-day product agenda and the longer-term development of the pension offering.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Global Mobility Manager to join our office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Team

You will join a global People team of more than 15 colleagues with diverse responsibilities and mandates. You will be part of the HR Legal & Mobility team, which comprises six colleagues.

Role

As Global Mobility Manager, you will manage global mobility cases and key operational workstreams across global tax, social security, immigration and relocation.

You will advise internal stakeholders on mobility processes, coordinate complex cross-border matters with specialist advisers, and ensure timely delivery in line with Mobility Policies and approval requirements.

Working closely with People, Payroll, Finance and external providers, you will identify risks early and lead improvements to mobility processes, systems and employee experience.

Responsibilities will include:

• Manage mobility cases end to end across global tax, social security, immigration and relocation, resolving complex issues.

• Oversee mobility compliance, documentation and data controls, including timely and accurate reporting of taxable vendor benefits.

• Advise stakeholders on mobility arrangements and policies, turning global specialist advice into action.

• Manage vendor performance, costs and escalations, including invoice review and internal cost recovery.

• Support stakeholder reporting on mobility progress, costs, risks and recommendations.

• Support mobility process improvements, including workflow optimization, integration and data management, and contribute to policy updates and implementation.

You

You have a relevant university degree and 5+ years of experience in global mobility within an international business or professional services firm.

You have experience managing cross-border mobility cases, coordinating tax, social security and immigration, and leading operational workstreams.

You are comfortable advising business stakeholders, managing external providers and exercising sound judgment on when to resolve matters independently and when to seek specialist input or escalate.

You also have a genuine interest in using AI and technology to improve service delivery and ways of working.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Solid business acumen and ability to translate specialist advice into practical recommendations.

• Proven ability to own multiple cases and projects, coordinate contributors and resolve issues to deliver agreed outcomes.

• Sound judgment and initiative, with a structured, detail-oriented approach to prioritizing, anticipating dependencies and adapting to changing business needs.

• Experience optimizing mobility processes and implementing them within a mobility system is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Become part of Group Internal Audit and help improve Danske Bank’s resilience by delivering assurance for the Group’s second line of defense Regulatory Compliance function. You will assess how regulatory compliance risks are identified, monitored, challenged and reported, using risk-based auditing, data analytics and AI-enabled tools to deliver meaningful insight across the organisation.

What you will be doing

You will lead, or contribute to, audits of the Group’s second line of defence Regulatory Compliance function, assessing governance, risk management and controls across regulatory compliance.

In this role, you will:

• Plan and conduct audits covering areas such as compliance risk assessments and Group Wide Risk Assessments, risk-based activity planning, compliance oversight and monitoring, management information and reporting

• Perform audits of specific regulatory compliance risk areas, including market integrity and market abuse surveillance, conflicts of interest, regulatory engagement, conduct risk and emerging compliance risks associated with new technologies and AI

• Apply professional scepticism, data analytics and technology-enabled audit techniques to identify risk patterns, test controls and deliver impactful audit insights

• Engage confidently with stakeholders at all organisational levels, communicate audit conclusions clearly and concisely, and monitor the timely resolution of audit findings and risk mitigation actions

• Contribute to the continuous development of audit methodologies, data-driven auditing techniques and the use of AI-enabled tools within Group Internal Audit

About you

We imagine that you bring:

• Several years of experience in internal audit, compliance, external audit, consulting, risk management or a comparable role in financial services

• Strong understanding of regulatory compliance risks, governance frameworks and the role of a second line Regulatory Compliance function

• Ability to assess complex regulatory and governance topics and communicate clear, well-supported conclusions to senior stakeholders

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and project management skills

• Strong analytical skills and an interest in leveraging data analytics and technology-enabled auditing techniques

We welcome candidates who bring curiosity, professional judgement and a commitment to continuous learning. Familiarity with AI-enabled audit tools or specific regulatory areas such as market abuse surveillance, conduct risk or regulatory engagement would be an advantage, but is not a requirement.

What we offer you

We invest in your development through training that matches your career aspirations. You will work in a collaborative environment that values different perspectives, professional curiosity and innovative thinking.

As part of Group Internal Audit, you will deliver independent assurance, insight and foresight and gain a unique enterprise-wide perspective on Regulatory Compliance’s risks, governance and control practices across the Group.

Our hybrid working model supports 3 to 4 days per week in the office, enabling close collaboration, knowledge sharing and professional development.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you are motivated by understanding how regulatory compliance risks are managed at Group level and want to apply your experience in an independent assurance role, we would be pleased to hear from you. If you have any questions before applying, please reach out to hiring manager, Christoffer Øhauge Pedersen at chrpe@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 4 December 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!
